title: Sr. Project Manager, AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The Sr. Construction / Project Manager (CM) for APJC Construction in the Data Center Capacity Delivery (DCCD) organization is responsible for the construction of data center builds. The CM typically works on all phases of a data center construction project, including site development, shell construction, and phase fit-outs. They are responsible for the safety, cost, quality, and delivery performance of their build. They often need to engage with stakeholders to manage changes and react in a timely manner to unexpected situations.
  
  
In this offered role, the Sr. CM works independently to deliver capacity within their cluster with limited guidance and is expected to deliver Data center full builds including multiple full shells, with multiple ROMPs and Sub stations. Works with internal and external stakeholders including Design Engineering, Environmental, Technical Infrastructure Program Management, Power & Cooling, Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, Security, Finance, Commissioning, Controls, Energy, and Infra Operations. Is fully responsible for delivering assigned construction builds within the approved budget, and defines construction Build budgets by gathering requirements and individual site data, and securing the budget approval and funding required to complete the construction builds. Clearly communicates construction constraints to the project team, drives design reviews and changes, and manages construction general contractors to complete all aspects of a DC build per provided designs and specifications, and/or manages individual construction Builds to specifications. Delivers infrastructure build projects to defined cost, time, and quality measures and contributes to the development of these measures. Identifies and mitigates risks and issues on assigned construction Builds. Documents construction issues in standard reporting tools and complies with the project change control process.
  
  
The Data Center Construction Manager (CM) of Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL), the local data center entity in India, is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced construction project schedules achievable. Amazon Construction Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient data centers in the world.
  
  
**About The Team**
As a Data Center Sr. Project Manager / Construction Manager of ADSIPL you will be a part of highly creative, action oriented, efficient team tasked with building Amazon data facilities in India of world class standards. The person will be part of the Construction Management team for AWS Data Centers in India. This team is part of the overall Data Center Capacity Delivery (DCCD) team for APJC (Asia Pacific, Japan, China) region of which India is a part. The team is led by an India Construction Management lead with two construction cluster /zones – Mumbai and Hyderabad. Each region is led by a Regional Construction Manager who has a team of Construction managers who plan and execute the respective Data Center projects. This role will report directly into the BOM (Mumbai) construction cluster manager.
  
  
**About AWS**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil Engineering, or a similar technical discipline
* 10+ years of design, construction or program management in mission critical facilities experience
* Experience reading and interpreting construction drawings and specifications, or experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
* Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
* Experience defining data center system-level architecture, specifying/documenting performance and equipment requirements to vendors and contractors, communicating conceptual designs, and creating/maintaining project documentation before, during and after construction

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in construction management or construction program management of large, complex projects involving large-scale mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) plants
* Experience directly related to the design or construction of large data center facilities, either colocation or client owned/operated
* Experience managing and negotiating contracts and vendor relationships
* Experience leading large, fast-moving projects
* Knowledge of Indian as well as state building codes and regulations including Fire Codes, Building Codes, Energy Efficiency Codes, Sanitary Codes and Safety Codes
* Experience with large scale mechanical and power systems

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Principal Engineer, AI Platform
description:
**Job Role: Full Stack Principal Engineer, AI Platform**

**Office Location: Andheri East, Mumbai**

**About Accrete**

Accrete is an agentic managed services company: an AI workforce that does high-stakes, judgement-heavy work for government and enterprise clients — at the economics of software, not labor.

At the core is Accrete’s Knowledge Engine, a dynamic context graph that captures an organization’s tacit knowledge, resolves data across silos, and builds a living, auditable ground truth. Expert agents reason against that ground truth to act on complex, high-stakes decisions — not just answer questions about them.

From national security to commercial operations, Accrete delivers the work on one platform, with unlimited expert agents and expert judgement.

**Full Stack Principal Engineer**

**AI Platform team**

* Build secure REST APIs, backend services, validation mechanisms, authorization workflows, and multi-tenant functionality.
* Develop enterprise integrations, including inbound webhooks, identity integrations, bulk employee and organization imports, background jobs, file storage, and notification services.
* Maintain and enhance product experiences for employees, managers, HR teams, and executives.
* Develop features across competency management, assessments, development plans, evidence tracking, coaching, reassessment, and workforce intelligence.
* Manage day-to-day application CI/CD operations, deployment workflows, and release readiness.
* Implement observability, health checks, structured logging, error handling, and production diagnostics.
* Ensure complete English and Arabic language support, including right-to-left (RTL) layouts wherever applicable.
* Implement AI-powered features with structured outputs, usage controls, validation, auditability, and safe failure handling.
* Review and validate AI-generated code before merging or deploying it to production.
* Write and maintain automated tests covering business logic, authorization, database operations, tenant isolation, and critical user journeys.
* Troubleshoot production issues, investigate regressions and performance bottlenecks, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with the Integration Lead to develop reusable integration capabilities and implement client-specific product enhancements.
* Maintain clean architecture, promote code reusability, and prevent unnecessary technical debt or duplication of models and workflows.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–9 years of experience in full-stack software development.
* At least 2 years of experience as a Senior or Lead Engineer with significant ownership of a production-grade, multi-tenant B2B SaaS application.
* Strong hands-on experience with React and TypeScript.
* Proficiency in Node.js backend development and API design.
* Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL, including database design, schema migrations, indexing, transactions, and performance troubleshooting.
* Practical experience implementing authorization, tenant isolation, and database-level or policy-based access controls.
* Experience building REST APIs, webhooks, scheduled tasks, background jobs, and third-party integrations.
* Strong automated testing practices across unit, integration, security, and database-backed workflows.
* Experience with Git, GitHub, Docker, and day-to-day CI/CD operations.
* Working knowledge of cloud deployments, application monitoring, observability, production troubleshooting, and incident support.
* Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS security, idempotency, auditability, and secure secret management.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI-assisted and AI-generated code, with a strong focus on correctness, security, and maintainability.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of features from requirements through deployment and production support.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Drizzle ORM and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS).
* Experience with MySQL-to-PostgreSQL migration or production database cutovers.
* Background in B2B or enterprise SaaS product development.
* Experience in HR technology, talent management, assessments, LMS/LXP, or workforce platforms.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, or SAML-based authentication.
* Experience building multilingual applications, particularly Arabic and RTL interfaces.
* Experience integrating AI APIs with strict structured-output requirements.
* Exposure to Azure services, including managed PostgreSQL, cloud storage, secrets management, monitoring, and application hosting.
* Experience with queues, notifications, file storage, webhooks, and production observability.
* Experience working in small, fast-paced product teams with broad engineering ownership.

**About the Product**

You will contribute to an enterprise Talent Development Platform that helps organizations manage job architecture, competency frameworks, employee assessments, development plans, coaching, reassessment, and workforce intelligence.

The platform also supports integrations with enterprise HR systems and is built around a modern technology stack comprising
**React, TypeScript, Node.js, Drizzle ORM, and PostgreSQL**
, with PostgreSQL Row-Level Security supporting tenant isolation.

The role requires a product engineering mindset, with a focus on building reliable, secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions for enterprise customers.

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer who is comfortable working across frontend development, backend services, databases, security, testing, integrations, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting.

You should have experience taking meaningful ownership of a live multi-tenant SaaS product and be comfortable using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity without compromising engineering quality.

Strong communication skills, a practical approach to problem-solving, and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment are essential.

title: Sr. Director of Software Engineering
description:

As a Sr Director of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the within the Commercial and Investment Bank, Merchant Services, you will lead a global, multidisciplinary organization spanning the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific, with direct leadership responsibility for India. You will own both platform enablement—including secure, scalable Snowflake, data, and AI capabilities—and measurable business value through insights, automation, risk and loss reduction, operational efficiency, and improved merchant experience. Lead and develop managers, senior engineers, data scientists, analytics professionals, and governance teams while building a culture of accountability, inclusion, innovation, and continuous improvement.

title: Senior Manager/ AVP – IT Infrastructure & Trading Technology
description:
Abans Financial Services Ltd. is a listed, diversified financial services company offering a comprehensive suite of solutions across broking, commodity trading, asset management, financing, and investment advisory. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company operates with a strong presence in both Indian and global markets, serving institutional, corporate, and retail clients. As part of the larger Abans Group, the company continues to expand its footprint by delivering integrated financial services and building robust technology platforms to support its growing client base.
  
  
**Profile : Senior Manager/ AVP – IT Infrastructure & Trading Technology**
**Location: Nariman Point, Mumbai**
**Industry Preference: Stockbroking, Capital Markets, Trading, Brokerage, and Financial Services.**
**Job Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced IT Manager with expertise in IT infrastructure, trading technology, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance within the stockbroking industry. The candidate should have hands-on experience with hybrid infrastructure, exchange connectivity, CTCL trading applications, vendor licensing, and applicable SEBI and exchange regulations.
  
  
The role is responsible for ensuring the availability, security, and resilience of IT infrastructure and trading systems while supporting business operations and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* IT Infrastructure & Operations
* Manage on-premise and cloud infrastructure, including servers, storage, networks, and virtualisation.
* Ensure system availability, performance monitoring, capacity planning, and timely issue resolution.
* Manage backups, Disaster Recovery (DR), Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and periodic DR drills.
* Oversee IT asset management, software licensing, upgrades, and infrastructure maintenance.
* Stockbroking & Trading Technology
* Manage trading infrastructure like leased line connections, servers, licenses, etc for NSE, BSE, MCX, NCDEX, and other applicable exchanges and segments.
* Manage and coordinate with CTCL vendors such as Greeksoft, Resolute, ODIN, XTS, or similar trading platforms for software licences, vendor agreements, renewals, terminal registrations, and exchange-related approvals.
* Oversee configuration of CTCL/NNF IDs, terminal IDs, Location IDs, user IDs, and IP mapping, as applicable.
* Coordinate trading application installations, upgrades, testing, mock trading sessions, and exchange-mandated changes.
* Ensure integration and smooth functioning of trading applications, RMS, back-office systems, and market data feeds.
* Monitor trading-system performance and coordinate with vendors and internal teams to resolve technical issues.
* Exchange Connectivity & Network Management
* Manage leased lines, dedicated connectivity, internet links, VPNs, and network infrastructure for exchange connectivity.
* Handle IP whitelisting, firewall rules, routing, terminal mapping, and connectivity activation with exchanges and vendors.
* Ensure network redundancy, backup connectivity, failover, and business continuity.
* Monitor network performance, latency, and connectivity issues affecting trading operations.
* Cybersecurity & Security Management
* Manage firewalls, VPNs, antivirus, endpoint protection, and network security systems.
* Coordinate SOC operations, security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability assessments, and patch management.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, access management, and security policies in line with regulatory requirements.
* Ensure timely resolution and documentation of security incidents and vulnerabilities.
* Regulatory Compliance & IT Governance
* Ensure compliance with applicable SEBI, exchange, and other regulatory requirements relating to IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and trading systems.
* Coordinate exchange inspections, IT and cybersecurity audits, and closure of audit observations.
* Maintain IT policies, SOPs, infrastructure documentation, access records, and compliance reports.
* Oversee DR/BCP compliance, technology risk management, and required regulatory reporting.
* Vendor & Team Management
* Manage CTCL, RMS, back-office, network, cloud, and cybersecurity vendors.
* Monitor vendor performance, support escalations, licence renewals, and service delivery.
* Lead the IT team, allocate responsibilities, and ensure timely resolution of critical issues.
* Coordinate with Operations, Compliance, Risk, and other departments to ensure uninterrupted business operations.

**Key Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong experience in IT infrastructure, networking, servers, virtualisation, and cloud environments.
* Prior experience in stockbroking, capital markets, or financial services IT.
* Good understanding of CTCL trading applications and vendor licensing, including Greeksoft, Resolute, ODIN, XTS, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience managing & coordinating third party vendors and Endpoint Security solutions (Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, Trend Micro, Symantec, McAfee, SentinelOne, etc.).
* Experience working with SOC operations, SIEM platforms, security monitoring, incident response, and threat management.
* Strong understanding of Cybersecurity frameworks, Zero Trust Architecture, Vulnerability Management, Patch Management, and Security Best Practices.
* Familiarity with RMS, back-office systems, market data feeds, and trading application integration.
* Knowledge of firewalls, endpoint security, SOC operations, vulnerability management, and cybersecurity controls.
* Understanding of SEBI and exchange IT, cybersecurity, DR, and BCP requirements.
* Experience in exchange audits, IT compliance documentation, vendor management, and incident resolution.
* Minimum 5+ years of team management/leadership experience.
* Prior experience in Trading, Broking, Capital Markets, Financial Services, or BFSI organisations is highly preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting multiple exchanges and trading segments in a stockbroking environment.
* Hands-on involvement in CTCL implementations, exchange mock tests, system upgrades, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with trading operations, RMS, clearing, depository, and back-office technology.

title: Platform Customer Engineer, Manufacturing and Conglomerates
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.
* Experience translating customer objectives into integrated cloud solutions across multiple domains.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data management, data analytics, Cloud AI, networking, migrations, security.
* Experience managing the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, or penetration testing).

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business issues. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
  
  
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration testing within existing ones as a technical generalist. You will blend sales prowess, market knowledge and direct technical engagement.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting specific sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture to show the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots, and in-depth workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration, or implementation phases.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**
**Senior Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)**
The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline’s data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms.
  
  
We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production.
  
  
If you enjoy working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, data platforms, and machine learning operations, this role offers an opportunity to build platform capabilities used across Priceline.
  
  
**Why this job’s a big deal**
As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently.
  
  
You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams.
  
  
This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation
* Architect, govern, and scale enterprise-grade Terraform module registries and infrastructure-as-code strategies for GCP data and ML platform services.
* Provision, operate, and automate cloud data and ML platform services such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Vertex AI.
* Drive platform upgrades, lead capacity planning, and design operational improvements across development, QA, and production environments.
* Develop reusable automation and internal tools using Python and Shell scripting.
* Apply infrastructure-as-code, change-management, security, and auditability standards to platform changes.
* CI/CD, GitOps & Self-Service Enablement
* Define the CI/CD enterprise architecture and build governed pipelines for Airflow DAGs, Dataproc jobs, BigQuery changes, ML pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure.
* Implement reliable deployment, promotion, validation, rollback, and release processes using Git-based workflows.
* Set the strategy for GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, or equivalent CI/CD and GitOps tooling to improve developer experience and time to production.
* Design and engineer scalable self-service frameworks that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls.
* Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation.
* MLOps & LLMOps Platform Operations
* Architect and optimize production ML workflows covering model training, pipeline execution, model deployment, endpoint operations, batch inference, and retraining.
* Operate and improve ML platforms based on Vertex AI, Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies.
* Support model gateway and LLM platform capabilities such as LiteLLM, including model onboarding, access management, rate limiting, usage visibility, cost controls, and reliability improvements.
* Define and enforce repeatable enterprise standards for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage.
* Drive GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities.
* Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE
* Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services.
* Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Participate in on-call support, lead blameless root-cause analysis (RCAs), and enforce corrective and preventative actions.
* Architect IAM, RBAC, service-account controls, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance guardrails into platform workflows.
* Cost, Governance, Leadership & Platform Enablement
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead complex cross-team technical initiatives, and establish engineering standards for the broader MLOps and DataOps domains.
* Own and optimize cloud architecture for cost efficiency, actively managing capacity and FinOps practices for large-scale data and ML workloads.
* Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues.

**Who You Are**

* Degree & Experience: B.Tech or B.E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant.
* Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes.
* Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments.
* CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
* Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities.
* Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies.
* MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations.
* Reliability & Operations: Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems.
* Security & Governance: Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations.
* Operational Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience operating LLM gateways or GenAI platforms such as LiteLLM, Tyk, or equivalent model-access layers.
* Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems.
* Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity management, and FinOps for data and ML workloads.
* Experience applying SRE, security, networking, or compliance practices to cloud data and ML platforms.

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
  
  
**Health & wellness coverage**
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
  
  
**Generous time off**
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
  
  
**Work/life support**
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
  
  
**Financial security programs**
such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts
  
  
**Signature travel perks**
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
  
  
**Additional perks & discounts**
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
  
  
**A people-first culture**
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
  
  
**Applying for this position**
We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all
**current employees**
, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.
  
  
External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

title: Advisory Solutions Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Your Role and Responsibilities
  
  
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations

title: Solutions Architect IAM
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Solution Architect – IAM / Identity Security**
with
**8–15 years of overall experience**
and strong expertise in Identity and Access Management, Identity Governance, and enterprise identity security.

The role will be responsible for architecting complex enterprise identity environments and translating business and security requirements into scalable, secure, and implementable identity solutions using the Cymmetri platform.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working directly with
**CIOs, CISOs, enterprise security teams, customers, partners, Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams**
. The role requires someone who can think beyond implementation and own the complete journey from
**Business Requirement → Identity Architecture → Integration → Security → Deployment → Successful Production Rollout**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Identity Architecture & Solution Design**
  : Understand complex business, security, and technical requirements and design scalable end-to-end IAM/IGA and Identity Security architectures.
* **IAM & Identity Governance**
  : Design solutions covering Identity Governance, Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML), Access Governance, RBAC, Segregation of Duties (SoD), Access Reviews, provisioning, and de-provisioning.
* **Authentication & Federation**
  : Design and guide enterprise authentication and federation solutions involving SSO, MFA, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, and LDAP.
* **Enterprise Integrations**
  : Architect integrations with Active Directory/Entra ID, HRMS platforms, SAP, databases, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications, ensuring secure and reliable identity and access flows.
* **Security Architecture**
  : Incorporate security principles across identity solutions, including PAM, Identity Risk, Identity Threat Detection & Response (ITDR), Zero Trust, least privilege, and access controls.
* **Infrastructure & Deployment Architecture**
  : Design solutions across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments, including considerations for High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), scalability, performance, and business continuity.
* **Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**
  : Lead architecture discussions, workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and technical presentations with CIOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, security teams, and other senior stakeholders.
* **Pre-Sales & Solution Consulting**
  : Support Sales and Pre-Sales teams with technical discovery, RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, architecture presentations, demonstrations, and Proofs of Concept (POCs).
* **Implementation & Production Rollout**
  : Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams to translate architecture into implementation plans and provide technical guidance through integration, testing, deployment, and production rollout.
* **Technical Problem Solving**
  : Identify architectural risks, integration challenges, and technical dependencies and work with relevant teams to develop effective solutions.
* **Architecture Documentation**
  : Create and maintain solution architecture documents, integration designs, data flows, deployment architectures, security designs, and technical specifications.
* **Technology & Product Collaboration**
  : Work with Product and Engineering teams to identify product capabilities, technical gaps, and opportunities to improve enterprise solution design.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **8–15 years**
  of overall experience with significant experience in IAM, IGA, Identity Security, Cybersecurity, or Enterprise Security Architecture.
* Strong hands-on understanding of: Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML), Access Governance, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Segregation of Duties (SoD), Access Reviews / Certifications, Identity Lifecycle Management, Provisioning & De-provisioning
* Strong knowledge of SSO, MFA, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, and LDAP.
* Experience designing integrations with Active Directory/Entra ID, SAP, HRMS, databases, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications.
* Understanding of PAM, Identity Risk, ITDR, Zero Trust, least privilege, and identity security principles.
* Experience designing HA/DR, on-premise, cloud, and hybrid architectures.
* Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, AKS/EKS or similar container and orchestration technologies is an advantage.
* Experience with enterprise IAM/IGA platforms is preferred.
* Strong understanding of APIs, application integration patterns, databases, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Excellent communication, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities with an ability to assess technical trade-offs and recommend appropriate solutions.

**Role - Full time in office**

* Support knowledge transfer and capability building within the India Solutions team
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, QA, infrastructure) on integration and delivery
* Improving DevSecOps maturity and SDLC practices within the team

Technical & Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
**Experience Level: 8+ years**

* 7+ years with Java backend development at enterprise scale
* 5+ years with Spring Boot/Spring MVC in production environments
* Demonstrated good experience across the listed Technical skills.
* Familiarity with frontend integration using Angular/TypeScript/React
* Experience with legacy system refactoring to target architecture
* Active use of AI coding assistants in daily workflow

**Domain Experience**

* Banking, financial services, or similarly regulated enterprise environments preferred
* Experience in GCC or offshore delivery models advantageous
* Exposure to high-volume, high-availability backend systems

Technical Skills
  
  
**Required**
**Skill Group**
**Details**
**Core Java & JDK 21+**

* Modern language features – records, sealed classes, pattern‑matching, text blocks, and functional APIs (streams, Optional).
* Concurrency & Parallelism – virtual threads (Project Loom), Completable Future, Executor Service, Fork/Join, and basic lock/atomic primitives.
* JVM & GC tuning – G1/ZGC behaviour, heap‑dump analysis, JFR profiling, and module‑system (JPMS) usage.
* Logging / Instrumentation / Error Handling
* Build & Unit‑test foundation – Maven/Gradle multi‑module builds, JUnit 5 + AssertJ, static code checks (SpotBugs), and basic GraalVM native‑image awareness.

**Spring Ecosystem**

* Spring Boot 3.x – create micro‑service skeletons, auto‑configuration, actuator health‑checks, and simple security (JWT/OAuth2).,
* Spring Data (JPA/R2DBC) – entity mapping, query‑hint optimisation, reactive repositories, and transaction demarcation.
* Spring Cloud basics – service discovery (Eureka), API‑gateway pattern, externalized config (Config Server), and circuit‑breaker (Resilience4j).
* Either Spring Batch OR Spring MVC OR Spring Integration
* Spring Security– CSRF protection, OAuth2 resource‑server setup, basic role‑based access control, and token validation, zero trust, MTLS.

**Database & Data Access Engineering**

* SQL & query optimisation – complex CTEs, window functions, indexing strategies, and execution‑plan analysis (PostgreSQL/Oracle/MySQL).
* Database optimisation - (indexing, query plans). Understanding of partitioning
* ORM performance – JPA/Hibernate mapping, N+1 detection, second‑level cache, batch inserts/updates, and @QueryHints.
* NoSQL & caching – when to use MongoDB, GraphDB, Redis (session/Cache‑aside), basic data‑modeling, and TTL/eviction policies.
* Migrations & transactions – Flyway/Liquibase versioning, multi‑DB transaction handling (JTA), and isolation‑level choices.

**Design & Architecture**

* Clean / Hexagonal architecture – ports‑and‑adapters, dependency‑inversion, and keeping frameworks at the outer ring.
* Domain‑Driven Design basics – bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, and idempotent processing.
* API‑first & contract – OpenAPI/Swagger spec authoring, versioning strategy, and consumer‑driven contract testing (Pact).
* Event‑driven patterns – Kafka or RabbitMQ producers/consumers, out‑box pattern, and basic saga (choreography) implementation.
* Security: Public Keys / Hash Concepts. Design around Access Control, Role Based security.
* Microservices design Pattern ex: SAGA Design pattern

Concepts like -Circuit breaker, load balancer, Reverse Proxy
  
  

* Integration Patterns, Enterprise Patterns, Application scalability (stateful & stateless), Microservices Patterns, Distributed Transactions
* Caching Strategies (Redis, CDN)

**DevOps**

* Containerisation & K8s – Docker multi‑stage builds, Helm chart basics, pod liveness/readiness probes.
* CI/CD pipeline – Jenkins/Argo CD job that runs unit, integration, and static‑analysis steps; artefact publishing. Pipeline-as-code (Jenkinsfile/YAML)
* Observability starter – expose Prometheus metrics, configure a basic Grafana dashboard, and ship structured logs to ELK.
* Runtime security, secret‑management (CyberArk / Hashicorp / equivalent)
* Canary/blue‑green release patterns

**Testing & Quality Engineering**

* Test‑pyramid implementation – unit (JUnit 5/Mockito), integration (Testcontainers), contract (Pact).
* Performance & load testing – JMeter script creation, baseline latency/SLO definition, simple analysis of results.
* Static analysis & coverage – SonarQube quality gate, JaCoCo coverage threshold, SpotBugs rule set.

**Frontend**
Proficient working within existing Angular/TypeScript/NodeJS/NPM frameworks.
  
  
**AI Tools**
Daily use of AI DevAssistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate implementation across all skill areas
  
  
Understanding of MCP and Agentic concepts and able to develop and design.
  
  
Experience with Prompt Engineering, codebase context and constraints of AI assistants

title: SAP C-ALM
description:
**Position Executive Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Lead SAP Cloud ALM & Enterprise Toolchain Architect**
to define, govern, and operationalize the complete Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) strategy for our global Greenfield SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
  
  
Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance
* Strategy Definition: Formulate and execute a comprehensive Cloud ALM strategy aligned with SAP Activate methodology across all global rollout templates.
* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.
* Enterprise Toolchain Integration & Traceability
* Toolchain Management: Architect and manage data flows across the integrated ALM toolchain, connecting SAP Cloud ALM with enterprise architecture, modeling, testing, and operational tools.
* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

* Solution Enablement & Fit-to-Standard Execution
* Cloud ALM Configuration: Setup and configure SAP Cloud ALM for:

+ Business process hierarchy structure and solution documentation
+ Requirement, scope, and user story management
+ Test planning, script execution, and defect tracking
+ Task management and deployment tracking

* Fit-to-Standard Governance: Enable and support Fit-to-Standard workshops using standard SAP Best Practices content and Cloud ALM pre-delivered scope elements.
* Program Visibility: Design and maintain project scope baselines, milestone tracking, and real-time status dashboards for executive program leadership.
* Test Quality Management
* Test Strategy Formulation: Design and govern the program-wide testing framework (Unit Testing, System Integration Testing [SIT], User Acceptance Testing [UAT], and Regression Testing) inside SAP Cloud ALM.
* Multi-Regional Execution: Coordinate test execution across multi-regional teams, third-party system integrators, and varying time zones.
* Quality KPIs: Provide executive-level reporting on test coverage, defect burn-down rates, quality KPIs, and release readiness dashboards.
* Release, Deployment & Cutover Management
* Release Orchestration: Oversee release planning, deployment tracking, and release governance using Cloud ALM.
* CI/CD & Transport Integration: Connect Cloud ALM with SAP Transport Management and modern CI/CD delivery pipelines where applicable.
* Cutover Execution: Support cutover sequence planning, dependency mapping, and real-time deployment monitoring.
* Integration & Operations Readiness (Run / Hypercare Phase)
* Monitoring Setup: Configure operational monitoring within Cloud ALM, including:

+ Integration & Exception Monitoring
+ Business Process Monitoring
+ Automated Job Monitoring

* Operational Transition: Lead the transition of ALM artifacts from the project phase to Hypercare and steady-state operations (Run phase).
* Alerting & KPIs: Establish operational KPIs, threshold alerts, and health monitoring for steady-state governance.
* Stakeholder Leadership & Vendor Coaching
* Subject Matter Expert (SME): Act as the lead SME for the Program Management Office (PMO), System Integrator partners, SAP, and regional business leaders.
* Enablement & Upskilling: Coach and upskill project team members, functional leads, and regional business units on Cloud ALM best practices and standardized tool usage.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
SAP ALM & Program Expertise
  
  

* 7–10+ years of hands-on SAP implementation experience within large-scale enterprise environments.
* 3+ years direct experience configuring and leading SAP Cloud ALM (or SAP Solution Manager with a proven track record of Cloud ALM transition).
* Strong, practical knowledge of SAP Activate methodology across all project phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
* Proven experience in Greenfield SAP S/4HANA global implementations.

Functional & Technical Knowledge
  
  

* Solid comprehension of core SAP S/4HANA business processes (e.g., Finance, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Logistics).
* Hands-on familiarity with SAP Best Practices content and enterprise process models.
* Working knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g., Tricentis, CBTA).
* Familiarity with SAP integration technologies (SAP BTP, Cloud Integration / CPI) and SAP transport management concepts.

Leadership & Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven track record in stakeholder management within complex, multi-vendor, global environments.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across global teams, time zones, and diverse organizational cultures.
* Highly organized, structured, quality-focused, and proactive mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)**

* Official SAP Cloud ALM Certification.
* Prior experience in large-scale rollouts (multi-country, multi-template architectures).
* Exposure to modern DevOps principles and CI/CD pipelines within SAP enterprise landscapes.
* Prior experience in roles such as Enterprise ALM Lead, QA Lead, or Test Manager.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
**About us**

Triton Infotech works with large, diverse datasets for AI development and enterprise use. We bring together structured and unstructured data from many sources and prepare it for secure storage, evaluation and delivery.

**The role**

A hands-on engineering role. You’ll own the pipeline that turns incoming data into an organised, verified, usable repository, working directly with terabyte- to petabyte-scale data, storage hardware, cloud platforms and AI-assisted workflows. You should be as comfortable debugging a failed transfer at the command line as managing a NAS or designing a repeatable ingestion and quality-check process.

**What you’ll do**

* **Data collection and ingestion:**
  coordinate receipt of datasets from multiple partners in India and abroad, via disks, NAS shares, secure links, cloud buckets and hosted repositories, and build reliable bulk upload, download and sync workflows.
* **Centralisation and organisation:**
  consolidate incoming data into Google Workspace and cloud object storage (GCS, S3, Azure Blob) with clear directory structures, naming conventions, metadata catalogues and source-level inventories.
* **NAS and storage systems:**
  configure, run and troubleshoot network-attached storage (SMB, NFS, rsync, SFTP/SSH), including RAID, permissions, snapshots, disk health, throughput, backup and recovery.
* **Cloud infrastructure:**
  work across GCP, AWS and Azure (compute, object storage, IAM, CLIs, lifecycle policies, transfer tools, logging and cost controls), and choose approaches based on volume, security, performance and budget.
* **Systems work:**
  use Linux, shell scripting and Python to automate file handling, large transfers and transformations, and diagnose filesystem, network, memory and disk I/O bottlenecks.
* **File-format fluency:**
  inspect, validate, convert and extract data across PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV, JSON, XML, images, video, audio, archives, databases and engineering/CAD formats (DWG, DXF, STEP, STL, IFC).
* **Cleaning and QA:**
  find duplicates, corrupt or incomplete files, inconsistent metadata and missing records, using checksums, deduplication, schema validation, batch transformation and exception reports.
* **AI-enabled operations:**
  use Claude, ChatGPT and coding assistants to speed up scripting, classification, metadata extraction and QA, with proper review steps, and never share restricted data with external AI tools without authorisation.
* **Traceability and governance:**
  keep a record of every batch (when it arrived, where from, file count, size, format, changes made, access restrictions and delivery status), with least-privilege access, encryption and retention controls.
* **Operational ownership:**
  monitor ingestion jobs, maintain runbooks and dashboards, resolve transfer failures, coordinate with partners and the internal team, and deliver organised, verified datasets on time.

**What we’re looking for**

* Hands-on experience in data engineering, infrastructure, DevOps or systems administration, with large and varied datasets
* Strong Linux, Python and Bash skills
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and with large file transfers (rclone, rsync, cloud CLIs)
* Familiarity with NAS, file-transfer protocols, permissions and backups
* Careful, well documented and security-minded; able to own work end to end
* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science or a related field

**Nice to have**

* Experience with multi-terabyte or petabyte-scale repositories, Docker, Git, SQL or OCR / document-processing pipelines

title: Field CTO
description:
**Field CTO**

You own the technical truth of every deal you touch. Most consultancies split this into three jobs; one person pitches it, another owns the relationship, and a third inherits whatever got promised. Nobody owns the gap between what was sold, what the client needs, and what can ship. Here, you do.

**What are we looking for**

**real solver?**

**Solver? Absolutely. But not the usual kind.**
A technical deal is won or lost long before the contract. It happens in the first conversation, where someone either finds the real problem or sells the one they were handed. If you can walk into a CTO's room, find the problem beneath the brief, and design the one answer that will hold up under the client's scrutiny and our delivery team's, we want to connect.

* The technical voice a CTO trusts in the first meeting.
* Read a proposed architecture the way a CFO reads a P&L: where the cost sits, where the risk sits, and what it takes to keep it running.
* Asks the question the room was avoiding.
* Can say "not yet" to a deal that looks signed, and is respected for it.
* Thinks in systems: this architecture, this baseline, this commitment, for years, not just this deal.

**This Isn't for Everyone.**
But if you've ever sat through a pre-sales demo and wondered what the system would look like on day 300, we'd love to chat with you.

**Your Mission: The Role**

You are the CTO our clients wish they had on speed-dial: the one person who can speak credibly for everything Searce engineers, from redesigning the process to building the system, the platform, the guardrails and the rollout. You earn a client CTO’s trust in the first meeting, elevate Searce’s engineering authority with hyper-scaler partners (Google Cloud, AWS), shape the deal around the real problem, and commit only to what the right Searce squads can deliver.

Real problems never arrive sorted by service line. An agentic claims rebuild also needs a data platform, guardrails and a rollout plan. You compose that into one architecture, one baseline and one commitment. You work from first principles: find the objective before anyone names a solution, and add AI only where it removes a real bottleneck.

If you have built production systems, sold them to people who could say no, and then lived with what you sold, this is your seat.

**Your Responsibilities**

**Be the CTO in the room**

* **Own the technical conversation:**
  Lead architecture and strategy discussions with client CTOs, CIOs and engineering heads, and earn the second meeting.
* **Diagnose before you pitch:**
  Run discovery that separates the stated ask from the underlying objective, and name the broken process before any solution.

**Own the technical win**

* **Be the technical owner of the region’s deals:**
  Own the technical side of every significant deal, from qualification to signed scope, alongside Solutions Consultants who own the hunt and the commercials. Advise on which deals to chase and which to walk away from.
* **Compose one answer:**
  Assemble everything Searce can build, from process redesign to platform, security and adoption, into one architecture and one baseline, so the client gets a single answer, not a stack of separate pitches.
* **Hold the line from sold to shipped:**
  Agree on the baseline before build, and sign off the technical baseline of every SOW with delivery leads before it goes out, so the outcome can be verified at the end.

**Turn proof into pipeline**

* **Execute Outcome-Driven PoCs:**
  Architect time-boxed proof-of-value implementations tied directly to pre-agreed production KPIs and downstream delivery contracts.

**Show our engineering to the frontier Partners**

* **Make Searce’s capabilities visible to partners’ executives:**
  With the Partnerships BU, who own the relationship, lead the technical showcases for partners’ executives and field leaders: architecture reviews, live demos, reference builds and joint deal strategy.
* **Carry the partner roadmap back in:**
  Bring early product direction from our partners to practice leads, so the field sells what is coming, not what shipped last year.

**Make every deal smarter than the last**

* **Leave reusable assets behind:**
  Reference architectures, discovery playbooks and objection libraries, so the next field conversation starts at step four.
* **Sharpen the solvers around you:**
  Coach Solutions Consultants and Sales on technical selling, and feed field signals back to practice leads and Searce’s offerings.

**Functional Skills**

* **Executive Translation:**
  Turns architecture into business consequence for a CEO, a CFO or a partners’ executives without losing a CTO’s respect.
* **First-Principles Discovery:**
  Separates what the client asked for from what they need.
* **Whole-Problem Synthesis:**
  Sees how a problem splits across process, platform, trust and adoption, and sequences the work.
* **Commercial Judgment:**
  Reads margin, scope risk and delivery cost well enough to say no to a bad deal.
* **Influence Without Authority:**
  Aligns Sales, Delivery and partners’ on one version of the truth.
* **Structured Scoping:**
  Converts ambiguity into bounded scope, explicit assumptions and a testable definition of done.

**Tech Superpowers**

* **Builder Roots:**
  Hands-on engineering background. You have written, shipped and operated the systems you now design, and you can still read the code.
* **Enterprise Cloud Architecture:**
  Track record of designing distributed, high-throughput architectures on GCP or AWS, with deep expertise in FinOps, multi-region resiliency, and modern migration patterns. Advanced professional certifications (Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect / AWS Solutions Architect Professional) preferred.
* **Frontier AI Ecosystem & Lab Integrations:**
  Deep working familiarity with the frontier ecosystem, including OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, and emerging foundation model labs.
* **Data Foundations:**
  Has set data strategy and built platforms (lakehouse, streaming, governance) on BigQuery, Databricks or their AWS equivalents, and treats AI-ready data as a precondition, not an afterthought.
* **Agentic AI in Production:**
  Has shipped multi-agent systems with tool-calling, evals, guardrails and cost and latency trade-offs, beyond demos and chatbots. Tooling includes Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI), Agent Development Kit (ADK), Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, MCP and A2A protocols, RAG and vector databases, and frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI.
* **Reliability, Security & Adoption Discipline:**
  Has put CI/CD, test automation, SRE, observability and zero-trust security into practice at scale, and has shaped rollouts of AI into everyday work (Google Workspace, Gemini Enterprise) with working fluency, not depth.

**Experience & Relevance**

* 15+ years in engineering, architecture or technology leadership; B.E./B.Tech/M.S. in CS or equivalent.
* Has run technology as a CTO, VP Engineering, founder or equivalent, including at least one stint where you built, pivoted and scaled under real constraints.

  You’ve already tried to automate a real-world process like Claims, Invoicing, or Onboarding using AI.

  You’ve worked in an environment where you had to wear multiple hats and solve "0→1" problems.

If you are excited by the possibilities of what an AI-native, engineering-led, modern tech consultancy can do to futurify businesses,
**apply here**
and experience the ‘

’.
