title: Senior Specialist - Architecture
description:
**Role Description**
**Role Summary**

* Customer-facing technical owner for opportunities and implementations.
* Convert media, data and AI problems into secure, scalable and production-ready solutions.
* Own architecture from discovery and pilot through engineering, deployment and handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery with customer business, product, data, AI, security and engineering teams.
* Define use cases, target workflows, architecture, integrations, data flows, non-functional requirements and roadmaps.
* Preserve a reusable, model-agnostic core while allowing controlled customer configuration.
* Assess data readiness, model fit, integration effort, cost, assumptions and delivery risks.
* Support proposals and SOWs, and remain accountable through architecture reviews and production sign-off.

AI, Platform & Cloud Architecture
  
  

* Apply deep knowledge of video/multimodal AI, computer vision, speech AI, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, reranking, RAG, recommendations and agentic workflows.
* Turn model outputs into reliable decisions using metadata, ontology, business rules, confidence thresholds, ranking, temporal logic, human review and feedback.
* Define model evaluation across accuracy, precision, recall, relevance, temporal grounding, latency, throughput, explainability and cost.
* Design AI pipelines for ingestion, preprocessing, retrieval, inference, validation, feedback and continuous evaluation.
* Architect APIs, microservices, event-driven services, workflow engines, vector databases, model serving and enterprise integrations.
* Integrate with MAM/DAM, CMS, media supply chain, data platforms, OTT/player, AdTech, localization and observability systems.
* Define Hyperscaler deployment, Kubernetes/container patterns, security, resilience, observability, DR and cost controls.
* Shape MLOps for model/prompt versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, rollback, lineage and cost tracking.

**Hands-On & Collaboration**

* Create or review prototypes, APIs, notebooks, model evaluations, architecture diagrams and deployment designs.
* Inspect payloads, logs, traces, model outputs and performance metrics to resolve issues with engineering teams.
* Guide AI/ML, Data, Backend, Frontend, DevOps and QA teams on architecture and quality standards.
* Partner closely with the Product Lead and Engineering Head on reusable capabilities and implementation sequencing.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 9–10 years of technology experience, including Building and shipping AI Saas products / solutions , solution architecture, enterprise integration or cloud-native engineering ownership.
* At least 3–4 years of substantive AI/ML, data, automation or intelligent-platform architecture experience.
* Proven customer-facing experience leading discovery workshops, technical reviews and complex stakeholder discussions.
* Ownership of at least one solution from discovery or presales through pilot, engineering, deployment and handover.
* Strong knowledge of distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, data pipelines, CI/CD, observability and security.
* Hands-on proficiency in Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to validate integrations and prototypes.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and container/Kubernetes deployments.
* Strong communication, estimation, problem structuring, risk management and architecture-documentation skills.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline.

**Preferred Media Experience**

* Media & Entertainment, OTT/streaming, broadcast, studios, MAM/DAM, AdTech, localization, live sports, QoE or video-processing workflows.

title: IT COE Head [T500-30365]
description:
**About VIP (Vermont Information Processing, Inc.)**

We are the leading technology provider powering the beverage industry, delivering integrated software solutions that connect suppliers, distributors, bottlers, and retailers across all three tiers. Since 1972, from our headquarters in Colchester, Vermont, we have focused on optimizing daily workflows and driving efficiency, visibility, and value through innovative applications like KARMA and Order Stream for businesses of every size and type. Today, with over 800 employees across 20 states and 3 countries, more than 63,000 monthly active users, and systems that process over 80% of U.S. beer volume, we enable seamless data exchange, stronger performance, and industry-wide growth by working side by side with our customers.

**About VIP India:**

India’s deep and diverse talent pool plays a major role in our global growth strategy. That is why we have expanded our global footprint with the establishment of VIP India, a state-of-the-art innovation hub in Mumbai. At VIP India, we are a high-impact, inclusive, and collaborative ecosystem where a community of talented professionals come together to drive digital innovation and transform the global beverage industry.

**Life at VIP India:**

Life at VIP India reflects our belief that great work happens when people are both challenged and cared for. An enjoyable work environment, flexible/hybrid options, and benefits that promote well-being and work-life balance encourage you to bring your best self to work.

As part of the wider VIP community, India teams share in traditions of giving back and team building—from local initiatives to supporting broader company efforts that strengthen our communities. If you want to grow your career, stay close to the latest in industry technology, and be part of a team that genuinely looks out for one another, VIP India is the place to grow together.

**Job Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and hands-on IT COE Head to scale our Global Capability Center (GCC) operations in India. Working in close partnership with US Executive Leadership and India Executive Leadership, the role holder will drive end-to-end technology infrastructure, cloud environments, enterprise security, and compliance. This role bridges global strategic vision with India operational capabilities—acting as a trusted technology co-partner across both regions while building, mentoring, and leading high-performing IT teams locally. Vermont Information Processing

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Strategic & Global Alignment: Work in close partnership with US IT Leadership and India Leadership to align the India GCC technology roadmap, infrastructure strategies, and digital/AI initiatives with global enterprise goals.
* GCC IT Operations & Governance: Partner with India Executive Leadership to direct day-to day enterprise IT operations, infrastructure availability, service management, and end-user support across the GCC.
* IT Steering & Risk Management: Establish local IT governance, report on security KPIs, compliance posture, and technology risk metrics to executive leadership.
* Vendor & Asset Management: Oversee local IT procurement, cloud vendor relationships, software licensing, and hardware assets, driving cost optimization and efficiency. Cloud Infrastructure & Enterprise Systems
* Cloud Architecture: Oversee secure, scalable, and resilient cloud/multi-cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Modernization & Migration: Lead infrastructure modernization programs, cloud migrations, containerization, and virtual machine management.
* Enterprise Tooling & AI Integration: Implement automated IT workflows, endpoint management (O365, Active Directory), and AI/ML-driven internal tooling to improve operational velocity.
* Reliability & DR: Ensure availability, continuous monitoring, and robust Disaster Recovery (DR) and business continuity strategies. Cybersecurity, Compliance & DevSecOps
* Security & Zero Trust: Enforce enterprise-wide Zero-Trust security frameworks, IAM controls, endpoint compliance, and data loss prevention (DLP) policies.
* Compliance Standards: Lead local execution and maintenance of security certifications and regulatory frameworks such as SOC1, SOC2, and data protection policies.
* Incident Response & SRE: Establish monitoring, observability and incident response frameworks to maintain low MTTR and proactive threat remediation. Vermont Information Processing Team Building & Stakeholder

**Management:**

* Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and manage a multi-disciplinary team spanning Cloud/Infra Ops, DevOps, IT Support, and Security.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a key liaison between US stakeholders, local business leadership to ensure clear communication and smooth delivery.
* Required Qualifications & Experience:
* Experience: 15–20+ years of total experience in IT infrastructure, enterprise cloud architecture, and technical management. • Leadership Experience: Proven track record in a senior IT leadership role within a GCC, multinational organization, or SaaS Base product company.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master’s in Cyber Security or Management is a plus).

**Technical Competencies & Expertise:**

* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on architecture and operational depth across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
* Security & Governance: Deep understanding of Zero-Trust architecture, Identity Access Management (IAM), SOC1, SOC2, and enterprise security stacks.
* Enterprise Operations: Active Directory, O365, MDM, ITIL-aligned ITSM processes, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and patch automation.
* Emerging Technologies: Familiarity with AI/ML tools integration, workflow automation
* Certifications (Preferred): ITIL v3/v4 Foundation, Lead Auditor/Implementer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Architect/Machine Learning, or PMP.

title: Solution Engineer
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
  
  
We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
  
  
Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
  
  
Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The System Solution Engineer is accountable for the strategic oversight, successful implementation and reliable maintenance of the core Customer Services technology stack, including systems like Genesys, Zendesk, Teramind, and associated Data & Quality Management (QM) tools. This role acts as the primary subject matter expert, ensuring system stability, optimal performance, and continuous feature adoption. The purpose is to maximize agent efficiency, ensure compliance and align the capabilities of these platforms directly with operational objectives to deliver a seamless, high-quality agent & customer experience.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* System Ownership & Strategy: Take full ownership of the technical health, lifecycle management, and multi-year roadmap for the entire Customer Services IT systems portfolio (including Genesys Cloud, Zendesk, Teramind, and integrated 3rd party tools).
* Cross-System Integration: Define and govern the strategic approach for integrating different platforms (telephony, CRM, WFM, QA) to ensure data flow, system compatibility, and a unified agent experience.
* Vendor & Budget Management: Manage key technology vendor relationships and oversee system-related budgets and capacity planning.Provide L3 subject matter expertise and guidance on how agents and supervisors can best utilize the appointed systems.
* Maintain an expert-level understanding of new features and market trends across the CS technology landscape to drive continuous feature adoption.
* Assesses situations to make appropriate recommendations based on operational needs.
* Adheres to support processes and best practices.
* Prepares and/or reviews functional requirements documentation.
* System Configuration, Development & Change Management: Design, develop, test, and deploy complex system configurations, integrations, and changes based on business requirements.
* Hands-on Coding: Write and maintain ad-hoc scripts, APIs, and microservices (e.g., using Python, Go, or JavaScript) to facilitate system integrations and custom functionality.
* Adapts to prestigeless work within a small team environment.
* Participate in operational meetings for technical guidance and solution proposals.

**Qualification /Personal Characteristics**
**:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5 or more years of IT experience supporting applications and infrastructure in a contact center or large-scale enterprise environment.
* Proven experience as a solutions architect or lead engineer, with a strong portfolio of successfully delivered projects.
* Strong, demonstrable experience with Customer Service platforms (e.g., Genesys Cloud, Zendesk, Teramind, WFM systems).
* Expertise in designing systems on cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, APIs and RESTful services.
* Programming knowledge (Python, Go, or JavaScript preferred) for ad-hoc scripts and integrations.
* Ability to troubleshoot and diagnose issues related to hardware, software, VoIP or network connectivity.
* Strategic Communication & Stakeholder Alignment: Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical issues and translate system capabilities into business value for both technical and non-technical stakeholders (e.g., leadership, operations teams).
* Analytical & Problem Solving Mindset: Ability to think strategically, solve complex, cross-functional technical problems, and demonstrate strong analytical skills with a hands-on approach.
* Organizational & Team Skills: Prestigeless team player with strong organizational, detailed orientation, and planning skills to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences.

**Benefits**
What’s in it for You?
  
  

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Confidential, free support for personal or work-related challenges—covering counseling, or financial guidance, and more—to help maintain well-being and performance.
* Term Life Insurance: Provides financial peace of mind for your loved ones with a fixed-coverage death benefit over a defined term. Affordable protection offered by your employer.
* Mediclaim (Health Insurance): Extensive coverage for medical expenses to ensure you and your family get the care you need when it matters.
* Meal Coupons: A tasty perk to fuel your workday—delicious meals or snacks on us!
* Performance-Based Incentives: Earn more when you deliver more. Your hard work pays off—literally.
* Learning & Development (L&D) Sessions: Continued growth through curated upskilling sessions—boosting your skills and career progression.

Diversity disclaimer
  
  
*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.*
*During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.*

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Mumbai
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines (Apna) builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Vice President, Application Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As a VP, Java Back-End Engineer, you’ll lead by example — architecting, coding, and mentoring teams to build resilient systems that power our global post-trade operations. You’ll design and deliver enterprise-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. This role is ideal for a technical leader who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding design decisions, and solving complex data challenges — all while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. About Post Trade Accounting (PTA) A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock’s largest engineering investments. Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Expanding into data analytics and pipeline initiatives using Snowflake, Redis, and distributed event streaming and messaging platforms to manage high-volume, real-time data. Collaborates closely with Product, Operations, and other Engineering teams to deliver business-critical capabilities. Agile and collaborative environment that values technical depth, quality, and innovation. Key Responsibilities Design and develop robust, high-performance back-end systems using Java 11+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem. Lead design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands-on approach. Build and maintain microservices and event-driven systems to process and distribute large-scale financial data. Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real-time streaming platforms. Implement and optimize Redis-based caching and data stores for low-latency access patterns. Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning. Mentor engineers to elevate technical craftsmanship, problem-solving, and design thinking. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure technical solutions align with product goals and business outcomes. Qualifications / Competencies B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. 8+ years of professional experience in Java and object-oriented design. Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns. Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modeling. Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence. Hands-on exposure to distributed event streaming and messaging platforms or similar publish-subscribe systems for real-time event processing. Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming). Experience with Agentic coding and general understanding of how LLMs are working Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production readiness. Excellent communication and leadership skills — able to guide teams and influence design direction. Nice to Have Experience with Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, or cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP). Exposure to observability tools (metrics collection, Grafana, Open Telemetry). Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis. Exposure to Prompt Engineering and Agentic AI Interest in financial systems, accounting, or investment technology.
  
  
**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Engineer, Public Markets Technology
description:
**Purpose. Performance. People.**
Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.
  
  
With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.
  
  
For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Software Engineer, you will participate in the design, build, test and support of value-add technology solutions and products. You will also work in close partnership with business and technology teams and will acquire sufficient understanding of business and technology to apply critical thought to business and technology requests.
  
  
**The Team**
**Core Accountabilities**

* Participate in the design, build, test and support of technology solutions or enhancements to enable business capabilities, in an Agile environment that includes business and T&D partner teams.
* Apply an understanding of engineering best practices and participate in continuous improvement across the team.
* Build an understanding of the technical landscape and the business capabilities it supports and apply critical thought to business requests
* Demonstrate agility and innovation by participating in experimentation and solicitation of early feedback ensuring responsiveness to evolving business needs.
* Participate with colleagues to help frame and think deeply about problems identifying options
* Contribute to root cause analysis of operational incidents impacting the products supported by the team
* Adhere to Agile SDLC and execute related duties as required.
* Maintain strong relationships with business partners, peer IT teams and vendor partners

**Core Qualifications (Education And Experience)**

* Undergraduate degree or college diploma in related field (e.g. Engineering, Computer Science).
* 5+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Python, with experience in Pandas and API development
* Experience developing and deploying cloud-native applications on AWS and Gen AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude)
* Strong SQL skills and experience in structured and large-scale financial datasets.
* Solid understanding of software development best practices, design patterns, and testing frameworks.
* Experience working in Agile environments with exposure to DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.
  
  
We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.
  
  
**Inclusion & Accessibility**
CPP Investments is committed to equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.
  
  
**Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud**
CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.
  
  
CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

title: AI/ML Expert
description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled
**AI/ML Expert**
to lead and innovate in the development of advanced machine learning solutions, with a focus on large language models (LLMs) and generative AI tools. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in designing, deploying, and optimizing AI models, leveraging cutting-edge frameworks and infrastructure. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to build scalable AI applications, enhance existing models, and explore new AI-driven solutions to meet business objectives.
  
  
**About You**
4+ years in professional ML engineering, with at least 1+ years focused strictly on LLMs and generative AI tools.
  
  
Languages: Expert-level Python.
  
  
AI Frameworks: Deep experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
  
  
Agentic Frameworks: Proven hands-on production experience with LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
  
  
Data Infrastructure: Proficiency with vector databases like Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant, or Chroma.
  
  
Deployment Tools: Experience with vLLM, Ollama, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  
  
You bring passion, energy, taste for exploration and adaptability. You seek the opportunity to expand your knowledge and develop new skills.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you excited to work with the team that enables India’s conglomerates to build innovative services with AWS, scaling to serve billion+ Indians? The Conglomerates team in AWS India is looking for a Solutions Architect who can work with our customers who are augmenting their existing business empires with new business models on the foundations of payment infrastructure like UPI, quick commerce, widespread 5G internet access, affordable smartphones, exploding digital content, identity infrastructure like Aadhaar and world class AI & cloud infrastructure. #aws-ags-India
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Your broad responsibilities will include, owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing deep expertise in the AWS technologies as well as broad know-how around how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform. An ideal candidate should have worked on solution design & architecture of as part of a CoE, Cloud Practice team etc. Candidate must have have in-depth experience one or more of following technologies - Full stack application development/ DevOps / Databases / Networking / Security / Observability / Data Analytics & AIML. Good understanding of patterns and frameworks and ability to identify trade-offs is required. Candidate should have a flair for hands-on coding to do Proof of Concepts and demonstrate technologies. Candidate should be good at identifying repeatable pattern and best practices, and able to learn new technologies and customer business domain.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess customer facing skills that will allow them to represent AWS India well within a customer’s or partner's environment and drive discussions with mid to senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (DEI) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The selected candidate will work with subsidiairies / JV of large Indian conglomerates to map business requirements to technology. This will include but not limited to, understanding various design patterns & discern between various data & compute technologies. The candidate will also ensure right TCO while meeting the functional & non-functional requirements. The candidate will also guide on building DevSecOps, Observability & Monitoring of Infrastructure & Applications; conduct Well Architected Reviews; partner with AWS Domain & Technology Specialists to implement innovative solutions; collaborate with the Service Teams to identify feature gaps & engage with Technical communities and Customer C-Suite on Technology strategy & Best practices.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Conglomerates team is one of the most diverse teams you would ever get in your career. Our team members have deep technology experience spanning areas of Analytics, IoT, AI/ML, GenAI, Observability, Resiliency & Security. Top it up with years of domain expertise across Automotive, Manufacturing, e-Commerce, Telco, Travel & Hospitality - this is the team where Tech meets Business for the largest movers & shakers of India's push to $5T economy.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

* Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs

title: Sr. Delivery Consultant, Customer Experience, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specializing in Amazon Connect Customer Experience to join AWS Professional Services. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver complex customer experience solutions on Amazon Connect, serving as the technical authority for enterprise-grade contact center transformations. You will spend \*\*80% of your time\*\* hands-on — architecting and implementing CX solutions — while leading pre-sales engagements, driving team capability development, and integrating AI-native approaches into every engagement.
  
  
This is a customer-facing delivery leadership role that combines deep technical execution with strategic consulting, pre-sales leadership, and practice development.
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

## Required Qualifications
  
  
### Technical Expertise
  
  

* \*\*10+ years\*\* of hands-on experience designing and implementing Amazon Connect solutions (or equivalent enterprise contact center platforms with 3+ years on Connect)
* \*\*Deep proficiency\*\* in Amazon Connect ecosystem: Contact Flows, Routing Profiles, Contact Lens, Amazon Q in Connect, Lex, Outbound Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, and Customer Profiles
* \*\*Strong software engineering skills\*\* — Python, TypeScript/Node.js, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS)
* \*\*AI/ML competency\*\* — practical experience implementing generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, LLM-based agents, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and conversational AI (Lex, Q in Connect)
* \*\*Integration expertise\*\* — building production integrations with CRM/ITSM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk), telephony (SIP/PSTN), and workforce management platforms
* \*\*Architecture at scale\*\* — designing multi-region, multi-tenant, highly available contact center architectures handling 10,000+ concurrent contacts

### Consulting & Leadership
  
  

* \*\*Pre-sales experience\*\* — led or co-led 5+ customer proposals/SOWs including effort estimation, delivery planning, and technical presentations to senior stakeholders
* \*\*Delivery leadership\*\* — managed end-to-end delivery on engagements with 5+ team members, navigating scope changes, customer escalations, and go-live coordination
* \*\*Stakeholder management\*\* — demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with VP/C-level customer stakeholders
* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions

### Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
  
  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)

\* \* \*
  
  
## Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step-by-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK
* Knowledge of \*\*contact center operations\*\* — WFM, quality management, compliance recording, PCI-DSS, HIPAA considerations
* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking

\* \* \*
  
  
## Working Model
  
  

* \*\*80% Delivery:\*\* Hands-on customer engagements — designing, building, deploying Connect CX solutions
* \*\*10% Pre-Sales:\*\* Discovery workshops, proposals, estimations, customer presentations
* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration

\* \* \*
  
  
## About the Team
  
  
AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. The Connect CX practice delivers contact center modernization, AI-powered customer experience solutions, and omnichannel transformation programs for some of the world's largest organizations.
  
  
We are builders who are obsessed with customer outcomes, thrive in ambiguity, and believe the best solutions come from deep technical expertise combined with genuine curiosity about customer problems.
  
  
\* \* \*
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Delivery (80%)

Architect and deliver complex Amazon Connect implementations including multi-channel (voice, chat, email, task) contact center solutions for enterprise customers
  
  

* Design end-to-end CX solutions encompassing contact flows, routing strategies, agent workspaces, real-time and historical analytics, workforce management integration, and omnichannel orchestration
* Lead technical delivery on engagements valued at $1M+ — owning architecture decisions, HLD/LLD documentation, implementation patterns, and production go-live
* Build production-grade integrations with CRM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow), backend applications, and third-party platforms using Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, and Step Functions
* Implement AI-powered capabilities including Amazon Q in Connect, Contact Lens, Lex-based conversational AI, generative AI agents, sentiment analysis, real-time transcription, and intelligent routing
* Design and deploy agentic AI solutions multi-agent orchestration, tool-calling frameworks, prompt engineering, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows within the contact center context
* Ensure operational excellence establish monitoring (CloudWatch, Contact Lens), alerting, disaster recovery, and performance optimization for production contact center environments
* Create reusable delivery accelerators CDK constructs, solution patterns, reference architectures, and automation frameworks that reduce future engagement timelines
* Pre-Sales Leadership (10%)
* Lead customer discovery conduct workshops, ideation sessions, and technical deep-dives to understand customer pain points and define CX transformation roadmaps

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. * Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona)
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

**Infrastructure Operations & Service Reliability**

Master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline required; equivalent combination of education, certifications, and progressive experience may be considered. 8-12 years of progressive infrastructure, systems engineering, cloud, network, or enterprise IT operations experience required, including 3-5 years of supervisory, technical leadership, or people management experience. Experience supporting ISO27001, NIST, CIS Controls or similar security/compliance frameworks preferred. Relevant Microsoft, Azure, networking, security, virtualization, or cloud certifications strongly preferred. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical priorities, risks, and recommendations to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
  
  
**About Us**
IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a global leader in technical consulting, architecture, engineering, procurement, construction management, commissioning, qualification, and validation services for technically complex facilities. Integration is how we think and work. It requires the ability to unite existing and emerging technologies into a process that reliably delivers products and accelerates speed to market. That end-to-end mindset allows us to be agile and anticipate challenges as we move projects toward operational readiness. IPS applies design and delivery expertise, client-side experience, and supplier-side insight to every project. We infuse our curiosity, our passion, and our commitment to partnership in delivering solutions at any scale. We meet our clients where they are and get them to where they need to go. title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi-workstream delivery programs ($5M+/year in professional services revenue) end-to-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect - Associate
* Experience creating and implementing large-scale programs
* MBA, or 6+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* 3+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Delivery Field Service Architect
description:
Job Description: Delivery Field Service Architect

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Delivery Field Service Architect to lead the architecture, design, and delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Field Service solutions. The successful candidate will combine strong technical architecture expertise with hands-on delivery leadership, ensuring that field service capabilities align with business objectives, operational processes, and enterprise technology standards.

The role will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions, overseeing implementation across the delivery lifecycle, and working closely with business stakeholders, product owners, developers, integration teams, and third-party vendors.

Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Architecture and Design

\* Define the end-to-end solution architecture for Dynamics 365 Field Service implementations and enhancements.

\* Translate business and operational requirements into functional and technical designs.

\* Design solutions covering work order management, scheduling, resource allocation, inspections, asset management, inventory, and mobile workforce enablement.

\* Define the architecture across Dynamics 365 Field Service, Dataverse, Power Platform, and related Microsoft technologies.

\* Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture principles, security standards, and technology roadmaps.

\* Produce architecture diagrams, solution design documents, integration specifications, and architectural decision records.

2. Delivery Leadership

\* Lead technical delivery from discovery and design through development, testing, deployment, and hypercare.

\* Establish delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, and technical workstreams in collaboration with project and programme managers.

\* Translate architecture into actionable delivery backlogs, user stories, and technical tasks.

\* Provide architectural guidance to development teams and resolve complex technical issues.

\* Manage technical risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies, escalating delivery blockers where required.

\* Ensure deliverables meet agreed scope, quality standards, and business acceptance criteria.

3. Dynamics 365 Field Service

\* Design and oversee configuration of Field Service capabilities, including work orders, incident types, customer assets, agreements, bookings, and inspections.

\* Define scheduling and resource optimisation approaches using the capabilities available in Dynamics 365 Field Service and the Resource Scheduling solution.

\* Support mobile workforce requirements, including offline capabilities, mobile forms, and field technician experiences.

\* Design processes for service requests, preventive maintenance, service-level agreements, and work order lifecycle management.

\* Evaluate standard product capabilities against customisation requirements, prioritising configuration and out-of-the-box functionality where appropriate.

4. Microsoft Power Platform

\* Define appropriate use of Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, and Power BI within the Field Service ecosystem.

\* Establish standards for Dataverse data modelling, business rules, automation, reusable components, and solution packaging.

\* Ensure appropriate environment strategy, application lifecycle management (ALM), managed solutions, and deployment pipelines.

\* Apply Power Platform governance and security best practices, including role-based access, least privilege, and environment management.

5. Integration and Data Architecture

\* Define integration patterns between Dynamics 365 Field Service and enterprise systems, including ERP, CRM, asset management, inventory, finance, and customer platforms.

\* Design integrations using appropriate technologies such as APIs, Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and messaging services.

\* Establish data ownership, data flows, synchronisation patterns, error handling, retry mechanisms, and monitoring.

\* Support data migration, reconciliation, and data quality activities.

\* Ensure integrations meet requirements for scalability, reliability, performance, and operational support.

6. Non-Functional Requirements and Governance

\* Define and validate non-functional requirements covering performance, availability, scalability, security, accessibility, and maintainability.

\* Conduct architecture reviews, design assurance, and technical risk assessments.

\* Ensure compliance with enterprise security, data protection, and governance requirements.

\* Identify technical debt and recommend pragmatic remediation approaches.

\* Establish reusable architecture patterns, development standards, and technical quality gates.

7. Stakeholder and Team Collaboration

\* Act as the primary technical architecture point of contact across business and technology stakeholders.

\* Facilitate design workshops, technical discussions, and architecture decision-making sessions.

\* Collaborate with business analysts, functional consultants, developers, testers, DevOps teams, and operational support teams.

\* Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, delivery risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

\* Mentor delivery teams and promote engineering best practices.

Essential Skills and Experience

\* Significant experience designing and delivering Microsoft Dynamics 365 Field Service solutions.

\* Strong knowledge of Dynamics 365 CE, Dataverse, and the Microsoft Power Platform.

\* Proven experience leading technical delivery across the full software development lifecycle.

\* Experience with field service processes, work order management, resource scheduling, and mobile workforce solutions.

\* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, APIs, and distributed systems.

\* Experience with solution design, architecture documentation, technical governance, and design assurance.

\* Practical knowledge of Power Platform ALM, managed solutions, environment strategies, and deployment practices.

\* Strong understanding of identity, access management, application security, and data protection.

\* Experience managing technical dependencies, risks, delivery constraints, and cross-functional teams.

\* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Desirable Skills and Experience

\* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Field Service or Power Platform certifications.

\* Experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Sales, or Supply Chain Management.

\* Knowledge of Azure integration services, Azure DevOps, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

\* Experience with IoT-enabled field service, connected assets, predictive maintenance, or AI-assisted service operations.

\* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.

\* Experience delivering complex enterprise programmes using Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery methodologies.

\* Experience with enterprise data platforms, reporting, and operational analytics.

Key Deliverables

\* End-to-end solution architecture and technical design documentation.

\* Field Service capability and integration designs.

\* Architecture decisions, standards, and reusable design patterns.

\* Technical delivery roadmap, milestones, dependencies, and risk assessments.

\* Environment, security, ALM, and deployment strategy.

\* Technical assurance and non-functional requirements validation.

\* Production readiness assessment, deployment support, and operational handover.

Success Criteria

The successful candidate will be measured on:

\* Delivery of a scalable, secure, and supportable Field Service solution.

\* Alignment between business requirements, architecture, and implemented functionality.

\* Delivery predictability and effective management of technical risks and dependencies.

\* Quality of integrations, data integrity, and system reliability.

\* Compliance with enterprise architecture and security standards.

\* Successful production deployment, user adoption, and transition to operational support.

Role Profile

Role: Delivery Field Service Architect

Technology: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Field Service, Dynamics 365 CE, Dataverse, Power Platform, and Azure

Focus: Solution architecture, technical delivery leadership, integration, governance, and production readiness

Working Model: To be confirmed

Engagement Type: Permanent or contract, depending on programme requirements

Modern Architecture Design

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – eApps
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Lead the engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure supporting third-party Enterprise Applications (E-Apps), with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary cloud environment.
* Own hands-on infrastructure engineering across cloud and hybrid environments, including secure design, provisioning, migration, deployment, capacity, reliability, and lifecycle management.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform as the primary tool, supported by Ansible, Python, and Shell scripting; use PowerShell where required for Windows administration.
* Partner with solution teams, Enterprise Applications stakeholders, security, network, and service teams to define hosting standards, technical specifications, operational readiness, and support models.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and promote standardization, observability, ITSM discipline, and secure-by-design practices across the E-Apps platform.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Operate and continuously improve the E-Apps infrastructure estate, including availability, performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.
* Design and provision GCP infrastructure using approved architecture and security patterns across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, certificates, logging, monitoring, storage, and secrets management.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and deployment patterns and develop Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell scripts to eliminate manual work and improve deployment consistency.
* Administer and troubleshoot web and application platforms including IIS, JBoss, and Apache, with understanding of Java application hosting, reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS offload, certificates, ports, and application integrations.
* Implement observability and operational insight using Datadog and GCP monitoring/logging capabilities, including dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, alerting, health checks, service-level indicators, and actionable runbooks.
* Apply ITSM practices across incident, problem, change, service request, knowledge, and major-incident management; maintain accurate operational documentation and participate in governance and change reviews.
* Act as a senior escalation point for outages, complex incidents, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, security findings, and recovery activities; drive permanent corrective actions.
* Establish standards and governance for configuration, access, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness of new and existing applications.
* Mentor team members and coordinate support coverage while promoting knowledge sharing, effective handoffs, and continuous improvement across the platform team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: 8–12 years of experience designing, implementing, operating, and supporting complex infrastructure and enterprise application environments, including high-availability and mission-critical systems.
* GCP — primary requirement: Strong hands-on experience with GCP services and architecture, including Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, SSL certificates, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Secret Manager, storage, and hybrid connectivity.
* Terraform — primary engineering keyword: Demonstrated experience creating maintainable Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, environment configuration, state management, policy controls, and automated provisioning at scale.
* Scripting and automation: Strong Shell scripting and Python experience for operational tooling, integrations, validations, remediation, and workflow automation; practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and application/platform automation.
* Web and application infrastructure: Hands-on understanding of IIS, JBoss, and Apache administration, configuration, troubleshooting, patching, reverse proxying, Java application hosting, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, and integration with enterprise applications.
* Observability: Good hands-on experience with Datadog and/or equivalent observability platforms, covering monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, synthetic or endpoint checks, and incident correlation.
* ITSM and operations: Working knowledge of ITSM practices and operational controls, including incident, problem, change, service request, major-incident, SLA, knowledge-management, and root-cause-analysis processes.
* Systems and troubleshooting: Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server, networking fundamentals, firewalls, DNS, identity/access, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL, and vendor-supported enterprise applications.
* Leadership: Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Working knowledge of AWS and Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud requirement for the role.
* Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, DevOps practices, and secure software delivery.
* Platform experience: Experience supporting SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, vendor-built applications, cloud migrations, and hybrid enterprise environments.
* Certifications: GCP, Terraform, Ansible, ITIL, or other relevant cloud and infrastructure certifications are desirable.
* Continuous improvement: Ability to use AI capabilities where they deliver business value and improve support, operations, and user productivity.
* Leadership behaviors: Demonstrates ownership, initiative, integrity, constructive challenge, collaboration, and an engaging leadership style; develops people and drives initiatives from idea through execution.

**SUPPORT REQUIREMENT**

* The role requires extended off-hours coverage, including overnight, weekend, and holiday on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs and the team’s operational support model.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: SAP BDC-DSP-Manager
description:

* Support business development activities, proposal creation, solution estimations, and pre-sales engagements.

* Collaborate with global teams to deliver complex transformation programs.

* Strong stakeholder and executive management skills.

We are looking for motivated professionals who are passionate about data, analytics, and digital transformation. They should be proactive, adaptable, and committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced consulting environment.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
